levels.chua_dat: Below the program's academic standard (Recent graduate or < 2 years of experience, GPA ≥ 3.0/4.0) or the CV does not clearly state GPA/major.
levels.dat: Recent graduate or < 2 years of experience, GPA ≥ 3.0/4.0
levels.noi_bat: GPA ~8.5/10 (3.5/4.0) or above, scholarship or top departmental ranking; major closely matches the applied track, or holds a double degree/supplementary professional certificate.

levels.chua_dat: CV shows no evidence of English proficiency (certificate, English-medium program, English-speaking work environment). Program standard: Good English proficiency (IELTS 6.5 / TOEIC 800 or above)
levels.dat: Good English proficiency (IELTS 6.5 / TOEIC 800 or above)
levels.noi_bat: IELTS 7.0+/TOEIC 900+ or has studied/worked entirely in English; confident presenting, debating cases, and interviewing on a panel in English.

levels.chua_dat: No leadership role shown: only a club member, or the CV shows no meaningful extracurricular activity.
levels.dat: At least one leader/lead-organizer role in a club, project, or event — with a concrete description of what was actually done.
levels.noi_bat: Club president / lead organizer of a large-scale event / project founder — with measurable results (team size led, budget scale, growth achieved).

levels.chua_dat: No internship/work experience relevant to: Major in Textile / Material / Industrial Engineering
levels.dat: Major in Textile / Material / Industrial Engineering
levels.noi_bat: Two or more relevant internships, or one internship with a measurable achievement (KPI hit, project actually shipped) at a company in the same industry as Decathlon .

levels.chua_dat: No evidence of analytical thinking: no quantitative coursework, data project, or case-practice experience.
levels.dat: Has an analytical foundation (quantitative coursework, strong Excel, prior case practice) — enough to pass the program's assessment/aptitude test.
levels.noi_bat: Case competition achievements or a real analytical project + solid tools (advanced Excel, SQL/Python if the track needs it) — ready for both aptitude tests and assessment centres.

levels.chua_dat: CV does not mention any award, scholarship, or competition.
levels.dat: Has taken part in an academic/case competition or won a school-level scholarship/award.
levels.noi_bat: Reached the final rounds or won a major competition (case competitions in the relevant industry, national hackathon/datathon) or a national-level scholarship/award.

levels.chua_dat: CV shows no genuine interest signal or motivation tied to Decathlon  or its industry; generic application reasons only.
levels.dat: Is passionate about manufacturing, innovation, and sustainable development; is curious, proactive, and ready to take on challenges; lives by Decathlon's 4 values: Vitality – Responsibility – Generosity – Authenticity
levels.noi_bat: A clear, specific story connecting personal motivation, prior projects, and understanding of Decathlon 's business/brand/values in Vietnam.
